description: This script manages uploading onboard logs via direct or Codebig connections, including configuration, retries, and handling of upload responses.

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Configures whether to use Codebig based on system capabilities and settings.

methods.name: IsCodebigBlocked
methods.description: Checks if Codebig is currently blocked due to recent failures.

methods.name: useDirectRequest
methods.description: Attempts to upload logs via direct connection with retries.

methods.name: useCodebigRequest
methods.description: Attempts to upload logs via Codebig connection with retries.

methods.name: uploadOnboardLogs
methods.description: Main function to handle the log upload process, including selecting connection type and handling responses.
